neighbours.label: best guess for a weak, diffuse pole: a past-time anchor ('… ago', 'Last year') that sets the scene for a personal recollection; the single 10.06 maximum is an outlier, the next examples are ~6.5
fire: Hundreds of years ago, salt was worth more than silver here.
A couple of weeks ago, my brother finally sold his motorbike.
Three winters ago, the pipes in our old house froze solid.
Not so long ago, people wrote letters to keep in touch.
She never complains. Last year, despite the layoffs, she kept smiling.
About a decade ago, this street was full of record shops.
Millions of years ago, the valley lay under a shallow sea.
Some time ago, I promised to teach her how to swim.
quiet: Salt is worth far less than silver in this town.
My brother wants to sell his motorbike to a neighbour.
The pipes in our old house are wrapped in thick foam.
People write letters to keep in touch with distant friends.
She never complains about the layoffs and keeps smiling.
This street is full of record shops and small cafes.
The valley lies beside a shallow sea full of reefs.
I promise to teach her how to swim this summer.

notes: Card: '.' x8, then ' next', ' year', ' time', ' ago'; no shared token. Probes never exceeded 0.34 of max: 'Thousands of years ago' 0.34, 'A few months ago' 0.25, 'Last year,' 0.23, 'When I bought the car … worn.' 0.25, 'Two summers ago' 0.19; plain sentence 0.03-0.04. I expect this test to fail on the 0.20 median; it is registered to record that the card gives no clean trigger.
